reasoning: Recent data in the last 45 days show one public general-election poll of the Idaho Senate race and no state-level general-election presidential polling. The Bullfinch Group’s August 13, 2026 statewide poll finds Republican Sen. Jim Risch leading independent Todd Achilles by 4 points among likely voters, which is the only quantified general-election margin available and indicates a narrow but clear R advantage in the Senate race. Structural context (Idaho’s strongly Republican PVI and Trump’s solid net approval) reinforces a Republican lean for both Senate and presidential contests, but without fresh head-to-head presidential polling, the Senate race margin is the only numerically supported figure.

sources.details: Statewide poll of likely 2026 Idaho voters finds Jim Risch at 34%, independent Todd Achilles at 30%, Matt Loesby at 4%, and 32% undecided, implying a 4-point R lead in the Senate race.
